basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old laid-back resident of Baton Rouge, Louisiana, juggling the challenges of unemployment while pursuing my passion for collecting Zippo lighters. I spend my time tinkering with my home server setup and diving into the strategic depths of Blackstone Fortress. I'm a night owl, often browsing Reddit in the late hours. Currently single, I enjoy engaging in community discussions around hobbies and personal interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT, having worked as a network administrator for several years. My knowledge is primarily self-taught, bolstered by various online courses and hands-on experience with home server configurations. My interest in strategy games is both a hobby and a way to sharpen my problem-solving skills.
